glyph_origin: Chu Wan-li (1948): Phono-semantic compound (形聲): phonetic 匕 + phonetic 匕. Shuowen interprets it as an ideogrammic compound meaning to juxtapose. Graphically similar but unrelated to 从, 尼, 化 and 北.
shuowen: Shuowen interprets it as an ideogrammic compound meaning to juxtapose.
senses: [bǐ] to compare; to contrast; to have a contest
[bǐ] to liken; to draw an analogy to
to be next to; to be near to; to stand close together; to lie next to
to cling to; to collude with
[pí] (obsolete in standard Chinese) used in 比蒲
